a:

i haven't seen anything in the wild, but this is what i would do:

function is_in() {
    return $('.checkbox input[type="checkbox"]').prop('checked').index($(this)).length >= 0; // this checks for element
}

$('.checkbox input[type="checkbox"]).on('change', function(){
    if(!is_in()) {
        $('.checkbox input[type="checkbox"]').prop('checked', false); // or else we could use jquery selector, but that does not look very reliable
    }
});

$('.checkbox input[type="checkbox"]:checked').removeattr('checked').prop('checked', true);

i haven't tested this, but that should be something you can try!
